Third-party libraries inlined into every exhibit page.

Each file in this directory is an unmodified minified build, pinned by version
and SHA-256 checksum in manifest.json. scaffold.mjs copies the bytes into the
page inside <script id="exhibit-vendor-<id>"> blocks; verify.mjs recomputes the
checksum of each inlined copy. The license notices below travel with the page
in an HTML comment.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Source: https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine, tag v3.17.1, dist/cdn.min.js
License: MIT
